Golden Designs GDI-B002-01 St. Moritz is a 2-person traditional barrel sauna built from Pacific Premium Cedar, designed for outdoor use, and powered by a 6.0 kW Harvia “WALL” stove with built-in controls. A bronze privacy tempered glass door and accent backrest lighting complete a compact backyard sauna setup that heats efficiently.

The St. Moritz barrel design is engineered to provide usable interior space while minimizing excess air volume, helping the sauna warm quickly for consistent sessions. Inside, you’ll find an interior backrest with accent light and an interior LED control panel dedicated to accent lighting, giving you a calm, low-glare environment for traditional sauna bathing. The bronze privacy tempered glass door helps maintain a more secluded feel while still keeping the entry bright and modern.

Heating is driven by the included 6.0 kW stove with built-in controls (with an optional upgrade to an 8 kW stove if you select that configuration). For traditional sauna bathing, the stated ideal temperature range is 170–185°F, with the sauna capable of heating up to 190°F under appropriate conditions. Whether you’re looking for short heat sessions after workouts or longer relaxation routines, this is a traditional stove sauna built around the classic hot-and-dry experience (with the option to add water to sauna stones as supported by your stove’s instructions).

To round out the setup, this model includes traditional sauna accessories: sandglass, bucket, and scoop, with thermometer inclusion also listed for this model by major retailers. Exterior hardware details such as stainless steel hinge and handle are also listed for this model by major retailers, supporting durability for frequent open/close use in an outdoor environment.

Electrical planning is straightforward but important. The product listing specifies 240V / 30AMP electrical service for the 6 kW stove (or 240V / 40AMP for the optional 8 kW stove), and also specifies 120V / 15AMP power for the lighting and music control functions. In addition, the owner’s manual for this barrel sauna states that the heater must be hardwired by a certified electrician and that extension cords or receptacle adapters should not be used. Plan a dedicated install that meets these stated requirements to support safe and reliable operation.

Golden Designs builds sauna products with a focus on practical home-wellness ownership—solid materials, straightforward controls, and a product lineup that spans traditional and infrared categories. The St. Moritz is positioned for buyers who want a cedar barrel sauna footprint that fits patios and yards while still delivering a true stove-heated sauna routine.
